editorial_position: 从材料、结构、声音与观看方式，读物件怎样进入人的生活。

art_direction.dominant_mood: 棕褐、奶油白与浅陶色，呼应芦苇、纺织与日常物件。
art_direction.background_logic: 沿用已确认的共享空间浏览与默认环境色，阅读背景保持克制。
art_direction.palette_logic: 封面与结尾采用深棕、奶油白与浅陶色；阅读沿用共享系统默认。
art_direction.type_scale_logic: 沿用共享阅读系统的中英文字级、行高与对齐。
art_direction.image_behavior: 官方来源图注明历史、海报与现场边界；权利不明的图像仅外链预览。
art_direction.page_density_and_tempo: 十二篇交错呈现设计、时装、音乐和城市展览，按自然图像比例阅读。
art_direction.core_visual_action: 原创封面以窗、唱片和针脚的抽象形状组织十二个观察位置。
art_direction.cover_composition: 纸色矩形、偏心圆与交错细线构成原创抽象图形，不冒充作品或现场。
art_direction.desktop_interaction_mechanic: 复用已确认的空间浏览和整期定位。
art_direction.behance_viewing_arc: 从设计师之间的差异，走向穿衣、音乐、城市观看和一间毛线餐馆。
art_direction.mobile_translation: 沿用手机自然滚动与共享阅读入口。
art_direction.mobbin_usability_constraint: 保持共享系统的键盘、无脚本、减弱动态和风格外观支持。
art_direction.quiet_ending: 暖色收束，沿用已确认的每日语录轮播。

closing_quotation.text: Culture lives where an object finds its public.

closing_palette.rationale: 深棕与奶油白保持长文对比，浅陶色呼应芦苇与针线；区别最近七期的蓝、绿、紫及浅纸底组合。

repeated_mechanisms: external official images with linked origins and owned non-documentary fallbacks
variation_review.exception_reason: 复用已确认的共享阅读系统；以十二篇当日选题、已核对的官方图像和原创抽象封面形成变化。

limitations: Non-production Preview only. Official images remain external links with local non-documentary fallbacks; official provenance does not clear reproduction rights.
This edition was completed in the evening under explicit one-time owner authorization. Actual preparation and lock times are retained; ordinary schedules and Production restrictions are unchanged.
Discovery checks include access-limited and unresolved subjects; those outcomes do not establish that there was no news.

stories.title: 一个展览，怎样展开 Black design 里的差异？

english.title: Many Ways Into Black Design
english.deck: The Nue Black Aesthetic opens at London’s Design Museum on 6 November and runs until 8 August 2027.
english.abstract: The Nue Black Aesthetic opens at London’s Design Museum on 6 November and runs until 8 August 2027. Guest-curated by Charlene Prempeh, its six sections bring together more than 100 objects across fashion, furniture, architecture, product design and sculpture. The museum names sixteen designers, including Samuel Ross, Bianca Saunders, Feben, Ini Archibong and Giles Tettey Nartey.

english.title: An Indian Ivory Figure in Pompeii
english.deck: Global Antiquity opened at Fondazione Prada in Milan on 5 November and runs until 1 March 2027.
english.abstract: Global Antiquity opened at Fondazione Prada in Milan on 5 November and runs until 1 March 2027. More than 150 works and artifacts explore cross-regional relations from roughly 600 BCE to 1000 CE. Among the foundation’s examples is an ivory female figure from the Indian subcontinent that reached Pompeii before the eruption of 79 CE.

english.title: Karon Davis Reconsiders the Classical Figure
english.deck: Karon Davis’s Wishful Thinking opened at Salon 94 in New York on 5 November and runs until 19 December.
english.abstract: Karon Davis’s Wishful Thinking opened at Salon 94 in New York on 5 November and runs until 19 December. Its life-size nude sculptures are made through body casts of friends, muses and models. The gallery connects the exhibition with the often absent Black figure within art history’s canon.

english.deck: MoMA PS1’s Masao Gozu: Windows and Bars opened on 5 November and runs until 15 March 2027.
english.abstract: MoMA PS1’s Masao Gozu: Windows and Bars opened on 5 November and runs until 15 March 2027. It places a 1972 photograph of a Mott Street window in Chinatown beside a 2025 photograph of the same location. Fifty-three years separate a recognizable place from a different moment.

stories.title: 一间满桌毛线的意大利餐馆

english.title: An Italian Restaurant Made of Yarn
english.deck: Kate’s Knitalian, currently at London’s Air Contemporary, turns the gallery into an Italian restaurant and delicatessen.
english.abstract: Kate’s Knitalian, currently at London’s Air Contemporary, turns the gallery into an Italian restaurant and delicatessen. Pasta, cheese, tins and desserts are knitted, crocheted, embroidered and sewn. Visitors can choose pizza toppings at an interactive station. The artist confirmed on 2 November that it was open until 5 December; Balineum and Euronews both give 30 October as the opening date.
